A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CReFT-CAD and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D. The complete material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original TriView2CAD experiments, including VLM comparisons, real-world evaluation, training ablations, and failure cases in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds results for three VLM comparators in Table 1.

M1.justification: Equation (2) changes the stated Task 2 partial-credit reward from selecting a proper superset of correct answers to selecting a proper subset. This locally changes the reward specification; the architecture, curriculum, and supervised post-tuning remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed or training was rerun.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same prefabricated-bridge-pier domain, 200,000 synthetic and 3,000 real-world samples, and dimension recognition, primitive counting, and composite-parameter tasks. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: Table 1 substantially broadens the comparison by adding Gemini2.5 Pro, Claude4 Vision, and GPT-4o across all eight prompt/guidance configurations. All seven original VLM comparators remain, while the separate SFT comparisons are unchanged.

E3.justification: The synthetic 80/20 split, exclusively real-world test set, parameter-level accuracy metric, four prompt formats, reasoning-guidance conditions, and training settings remain unchanged. Calling the Task 3 test set 'held-out' does not establish a revised split or evaluation design.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains the same CoT and training-task ablations. Appendix B retains its prompt analyses, and Appendix D retains the same four failure cases and explanations. The added baseline rows introduce no new robustness or diagnostic analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report point accuracies without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The added results follow the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds 24 accuracy entries for the three new comparators. For example, GPT-4o reaches 39.71% with reasoning guidance and an Answered Pair, exceeding the retained Qwen2.5-VL result of 33.64% in that setting. All pre-existing scores, including CReFT-CAD's results, real-world results, ablations, and appendix tables, remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation (2) replaces the superset relation with a subset relation in its 0.2-reward branch, correcting a mathematical definition whose original condition overlapped the mixed-answer zero-reward case. The explanatory paragraph still contains the old relation. No theorem, proof, or other derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: a two-stage curriculum-RL and supervised-tuning framework, the TriView2CAD benchmark, and improved reasoning accuracy and real-world generalization. Rewording does not materially strengthen or narrow these claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of reasoning guidance, CoT, masked training tasks, and real-world difficulty remain substantively unchanged. The limitation concerning insufficient accuracy in complex real-world scenarios and the appendix failure explanations are retained.

D1.justification: The hardware, batch size, optimizer, learning rates, image-size limit, 1,500 GRPO steps, data-generation instructions, and code/data access link remain substantively unchanged. Rewritten implementation descriptions do not supply additional reproducibility specifications.

R1.justification: v2 adds the SAIL-VL2 citation in the introduction and references supporting the Gemini, Claude, and GPT-4o comparisons. The existing related-work categories, novelty positioning, and relationships to prior CAD approaches remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Extensive paragraph rewriting spans the abstract, introduction, related work, dataset construction, methodology, and experimental descriptions. Terminology is standardized from 'Progressive' to 'Curriculum-driven' in Section 4, and affiliation, conference, and acknowledgment text is updated. The section organization and appendices are largely retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains three rows, Figure 2 receives small label and positioning adjustments, and text reflow changes page breaks. The existing figure/table organization, ablation display, and appendix figures and tables remain substantially intact.

improvement.justification: The additional Table 1 comparators strengthen the comparative evidence, while extensive editing and the localized reward-equation correction improve clarity and precision. The gain is limited: existing experimental findings remain unchanged, Equation (2)'s explanation still contradicts its corrected condition, and Appendix B continues to discuss only the original seven comparators.
